text: {"lessons":["My account is now slightly below its Period 1 value after rising to a peak, so I should judge progress over the full investment horizon and prepare for drawdowns—not assume recent gains will last.","I should keep enough cash for future contributions and opportunities, and size positions so no single stock or round of purchases puts too much of my savings at risk.","Buying Stock B after its price had fallen did not prevent the account from declining further; a lower recent price alone is not a reason to buy, so I should use a consistent plan tied to my long-term goal."]}
